{{Quote|I need you to take down Dain Pax and Tettsel Anker, sub-councilors within the Chirq Council.|[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Chun Solso|Solso]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DtCCSC" />}}
'''Dain Pax''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chirq Council]] [[Elite Council|sub-councilor]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Two Chirq Council members are being trained to extend the reach of the Chirq Council by starting chapters in Bela Vistal and Vreni Island. They must be stopped before that can happen.|Agent Solso, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DtCCSC" />}}
Dain Pax was a member of the criminal organization known as the Chirq Council. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], sub-councilors Dain Pax and [[Tettsel Anker]] were trained in the [[Second Elite Council Bunker]], near the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]], in order to start new Chirq Council chapters in [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]] and [[Vreni Island]].<ref name="SWG:DtCCSC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an investigation against the Chirq Council following the increase of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] traffic on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Seek Council|Corellia}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] successfully infiltrated a CorSec agent within the organization. Assuming the identity of the Chirq Council member [[Trins Evnar]], the CorSec agent managed to infiltrate [[Jzoro Quanera]]'s Chirq Council chapter in Doaba Guerfel. From Jzoro Quanera's database, the CorSec obtained the identity of the nine elite councilors and the locations of their secret headquarters.<ref name="SWG:TCCMU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "The Chirq Council: Moving Up" on Corellia</ref> The CorSec later assaulted the [[First Elite Council Bunker|First]] and the Second Elite Council Bunkers.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: The Elite Council|Corellia}}</ref> During the raid on the Second Elite Council Bunker, [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Chun Solso]] was tasked to prevent Dain Pax and Tettsel Anker's attempt to extend the reach of the Chirq Council in Bela Vistal and Vreni Island. Agent Solso thus hired an independent spacer who previously worked for the CorSec to help him in his mission. The spacer fought and managed to kill the two sub-councilors.<ref name="SWG:DtCCSC" /> Eventually, the Chirq Council splintered after the Chirq Council elite councilors were killed by the CorSec in the Elite Council Bunkers.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dain Pax was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DtCCSC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dain Pax was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
